name: 4-MEAP
summary: 4-Methyl-α-ethylaminopentiophenone (4-MEAP) is a designer drug of the cathinone class. It is a higher homolog of 4-methylpentedrone (4-MPD) with an ethyl group in place of the methyl group. 4-MEAP has been found in samples of drugs sold as 4-MPD.

uses.text: 4-Methyl-α-ethylaminopentiophenone (4-MEAP) is a designer drug of the cathinone class. 4-MEAP has been found in samples of drugs sold as 4-MPD.

summaryZh: 4-甲基-α-乙氨基苯戊酮是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C14H21NO，屬於一種卡西酮衍生物，2018年列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。

pharmacology.en: Little research has been published on it. Like its relatives 4-MPD and pentedrone, it is thought to block the reuptake of dopamine and noradrenaline.
pharmacology.zh: 相關研究很少。一般認為它和近親4-MPD及戊基卡西酮一樣，會阻斷多巴胺與正腎上腺素的回收。
pharmacology.zhHans: 相关研究很少。一般认为它和近亲4-MPD及戊基卡西酮一样，会阻断多巴胺与正肾上腺素的回收。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cathinones, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, sweating, jaw clenching, insomnia, anxiety, paranoia and a strong urge to keep redosing. Serious risks include heart problems, seizures, psychosis and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成卡西酮類藥物，可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、大量出汗、咬緊牙關、失眠、焦慮、多疑，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。嚴重風險包括心臟問題、癲癇發作、精神病與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成卡西酮类药物，可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、大量出汗、咬紧牙关、失眠、焦虑、多疑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。严重风险包括心脏问题、癫痫发作、精神病与成瘾。

fact.en: It was first noticed by drug-checking labs in samples sold as a different cathinone, 4-MPD, which it closely resembles apart from an ethyl group in place of a methyl group.
fact.zh: 它最初是藥物檢驗實驗室在標示為另一種卡西酮4-MPD的樣本中發現的；兩者非常相似，只是一個甲基換成了乙基。
fact.zhHans: 它最初是药物检验实验室在标示为另一种卡西酮4-MPD的样本中发现的；两者非常相似，只是一个甲基换成了乙基。
